status: frozen when the campaign manifest pins this file's sha256; applied once by rl/m7o_analysis.decide; never re-decided
experiment: three fresh runs of btt_policy_obs_v3_entities + btt_reward_v2 + btt_explore_cells_v1 (m7o_s{0,1,2}_x1, 3,072,000 policy transitions each, tick-0 starts only) against the M7n v3 runs m7n_s{0,1,2}_v3 (btt_policy_obs_v3_entities + btt_reward_v2, same profiles without the [exploration] table) as the matched control, paired by seed
question: Does the separately logged exploration credit, added to an unchanged btt_reward_v2 during training only, let PPO discover a crossing (a native-verified clear, a replay-verified qualified crossing or a replay-verified left-target break) from normal tick-0 starts at the same budget, without displacing target collection?

exp.initialisation: fresh model and optimizer state (the profile's construction; ckpt_000000000 must equal the fresh construction AND the M7n run's initial set of the same seed), empty exploration tables; nothing imported from either pilot attempt or any other run

ctl.reuse_condition: runs/m7o/_control/control_check.json PASS (R1: fresh 102,400-transition runs of the M7n profiles equal the M7n runs' ckpt_000102400 digests and episode rows in every seed) AND runs/m7o/_control/control_verify.json PASS (the M7n final and initial evaluation records verified, their tick-0 checks re-run, their clear and crossing candidate sets re-enumerated, every rule input recomputed and equal to the recorded M7n analysis) on the manifest's code fingerprint and executable; a failed check stops the campaign; replacement controls are never trained by this rule

matched: btt_reward_v2 (frozen values; the experimental arm's rows keep the v2 return and log the credit separately)
PPO of rl/configs/m7g: 3e-4, rollout 5,120 = 5 x 1,024, batch 512, 10 epochs, gamma 0.999, lambda 0.995, clip 0.2, ent_coef 0, vf_coef 0.5, max_grad_norm 0.5
N = 5 workers with one standby each (<= 10 game processes)
tick-0 starts only; no curriculum, prefix, anchor or archive
3,072,000 policy transitions per run; checkpoints every 102,400

the M7n evaluation protocol: initial + 9 curve points + final; 100 stochastic + 100 deterministic at initial and final, 60 + 5 at curve points; evaluation seed 12345; frozen parameters; btt_eval_metrics_v1; evaluation workers carry no exploration wrapper and no credit; every native clear replayed from tick 0 on a fresh process; every gate-2 candidate replayed and analysed by btt_qualified_crossing_v1
only_difference: the [exploration] table of the experimental profiles (btt_explore_cells_v1, beta 0.05, cap 1.0, grid_divisor 24, harmonic decay), i.e. the learner reward during training; compatibility views differ only in the exploration keys

populations_and_denominators.final label: the final checkpoint set (3,072,000 transitions) of a run, evaluated post hoc from tick 0: 100 stochastic + 100 deterministic episodes
populations_and_denominators.initial label: the run's own ckpt_000000000, 100 stochastic episodes (used for G of the experimental arm only)
populations_and_denominators.K[a][s]: native-verified clears over the 200 final episodes of the run (100 stochastic + 100 deterministic)
populations_and_denominators.X[a][s]: 1 iff at least one of the 100 final STOCHASTIC episodes has a replay-verified qualified crossing or a replay-verified left-target break (crossing_verification); the deterministic play is diagnostic
populations_and_denominators.T[a][s]: mean targets broken (exact Fraction) over the final stochastic episodes that are not verified clears; UNDEFINED (null) when that set is empty, never 0
populations_and_denominators.D[s]: T[exp][s] - T[ctl][s]; undefined when either is undefined
populations_and_denominators.G[s]: T of exp's final label minus T of exp's initial label; undefined when either is undefined
populations_and_denominators.diagnostics (never gating): L (target 2 by tick <= 2699 with >= 5 static right targets), R (all seven right targets by 2699), target-2 breaks and ticks, falls, seven-right episodes, deterministic collapse share (M7e definition), unqualified left entries, per-checkpoint curves; exploration credit per training episode and per slot, cells discovered, cap hits, voided and capped amounts, table sizes at each checkpoint set

native_verified_clear: an episode counts as a clear only when its canonical native actions, replayed from tick 0 on a fresh process, reproduce completion_time_passed AND completion_input_tick exactly (rl/m7g_k_run.verify_clears_in); a native clear that does not reproduce is an integrity problem

qualified_crossing_or_left_target_break.criterion: btt_qualified_crossing_v1 (rl/m7n_crossing.py): candidates = final stochastic episodes with a btt_eval_metrics_v1 first_left_entry or a left target in broken_ids; each replayed exactly from tick 0 (digest, consumed ticks, all actions, break table, first-left-entry tick); qualified crossing = over_wall entry (btt_reward_v3.classify_entry) AND btt_crossing_evidence_v1 path over_ledge AND a grounded takeoff AND a landing on a decoded left-side floor line inside the same left visit (not the failure step); left-target break = target 1, 6 or 8 in the exact replay's break table; a raw left entry or an off-stage fall is never a crossing; an inexact candidate is an integrity problem
qualified_crossing_or_left_target_break.arms: the same procedure and code path on the experimental finals and on the control finals (the control's documents already exist from M7n and are re-verified by control_verify; a control candidate that qualifies sets X[ctl][s] = 1)

conditions_any: the control reproduction check (R1) or the control record verification is missing, failed or bound to another code fingerprint / executable / rule
an experimental run is not verified (identity, fresh start equal to the fresh construction and to the M7n initial set of its seed, empty tables at start, provenance, rows, leak-free)
an evaluation label of either arm fails its verification (episode count, frozen parameters, tick-0 starts, metrics, artifacts, no exploration record in evaluation rows)
a native clear of either arm not reproduced by its replay
a gate-2 candidate of either arm whose replay is not exact, or a crossing document whose candidate set differs from the label's rows
an experimental run's exploration tables changed during evaluation (table sha256 after evaluation != after training)
a control label or a control checkpoint changed since the manifest
integrity_gate.action: stop; no decision is recorded; diagnose

conditions_any: fewer than three verified experimental runs
an experimental final label without 100 + 100 episodes or an initial label without 100 stochastic
a missing crossing verification of an experimental final
a stopped, failed or partial experimental run (preserved, never resumed)
incomplete.action: no decision; reported as incomplete, never as failure or inconclusive

gates_in_order.name: first_clear
gates_in_order.condition: (sum_s K[exp][s] >= 1 and sum_s K[ctl][s] == 0) or (K[exp][s] > K[ctl][s] for every seed)
gates_in_order.action: every verified clear and its checkpoint preserved; the credit is retained as a training mechanism for the next milestone

gates_in_order.name: control_clear_guard
gates_in_order.condition: sum_s K[ctl][s] >= 1 and sum_s K[exp][s] == 0: gates 2 and 4 cannot select the experimental arm (K[ctl] is 0 today; the guard is kept for symmetry)

gates_in_order.name: ceiling_broken
gates_in_order.condition: no guard; X[exp][s] == 1 in at least ceiling_seeds_min (2) seeds and X[ctl][s] == 0 in every seed
gates_in_order.action: the credit is retained; the qualified crossings / left-target breaks are already replayed and their traces, routes and landings documented

gates_in_order.name: target_regression
gates_in_order.condition: D defined in at least regression_seeds_min seeds and D[s] <= -targets_diff_min (-1/2) in at least regression_seeds_min (2) seeds
gates_in_order.action: the credit displaced target collection; not retained at this scale

gates_in_order.name: targets_up_no_discovery
gates_in_order.condition: no guard; D defined in every seed and D[s] >= +targets_diff_min in every seed
gates_in_order.action: target collection improved without a discovery event; this is not the mechanism's purpose and unlocks nothing by itself

gates_in_order.name: no_learning
gates_in_order.condition: at least no_learning_seeds_min seeds with G defined and G[s] <= 0 in at least no_learning_seeds_min (2) seeds
gates_in_order.action: the experimental arm did not learn from scratch at this budget

gates_in_order.name: no_discovery_no_regression
gates_in_order.condition: anything else: neither a discovery event (gates 1-2) nor the regression threshold (gate 3) nor the improvement threshold (gate 4) nor no-learning (gate 5)
gates_in_order.action: no claim; the credit's effect on discovery is unmeasured at this budget

precedence: gate 0 first; then incompleteness; then gates 1-6 in order and the FIRST applicable gate whose condition holds decides. Discovery (gates 1-2) takes precedence over target regression (gate 3): when a discovery gate holds AND gate 3's condition also holds, the outcome is the discovery outcome with the flag target_regression = true and the label suffix '_with_target_regression'; every gate's condition is evaluated and reported whatever decides. An inapplicable gate (undefined inputs) never decides and evaluation continues.
ties_and_boundaries: all comparisons are inclusive on exact integers or Fractions, never rounded floats; equal clear counts (including 0 = 0) are not gate 1; the per-seed clear comparison is strict; X ties (1 = 1) are not gate 2; D exactly -1/2 counts for gate 3 and exactly +1/2 for gate 4; G exactly 0 counts as no learning; an undefined D or G is neither above nor below any threshold (that seed does not count toward the gate; gate 4 needs D defined in every seed; gates 3 and 5 need their minimum number of defined seeds)

undefined_quantities.representation: JSON null; never a substituted number
undefined_quantities.T: undefined when every stochastic episode of the label is a verified clear
undefined_quantities.gate_1_2: depend on K and X only; always applicable
undefined_quantities.consequence: an all-clear experimental label with no control clear is gate 1 by K alone; an all-clear tie is inconclusive

not_evidence_of_success: exploration credit accumulated, its decay, cells discovered or any training-time behaviour
the pilot's +0.30 mean-target difference over 60 episodes (a stop-only regression diagnostic inside its band)
target improvement without a discovery event (gate 4)
reported_always: paired per-seed K, X, T, D, G with denominators
qualified crossings and left-target breaks with replay evidence
L and R per seed and pooled
exploration credit: per-episode distribution per slot over the run, first / last quarter means, cap hits, voided, capped, table sizes per checkpoint set
training episodes, throughput, wall, commit, processes
the control check and control verification identities

budget.exp_training: 3 x 3,072,000 policy transitions (hard maximum; no extension, no extra seed)
budget.evaluation: 3 x 985 = 2,955 episodes plus clear and crossing replays

stops: no automatic fix or relaunch of a stopped campaign
decision_recording: decided once by rl/m7o_analysis.decide on this frozen rule; recorded in runs/m7o/campaign/_matrix/analysis_n3.json; never re-decided
